title: Wild AG contact
description: A contact section on paper: at the left a light card with three pill-shaped fields outlined in soft taupe (name, email, a tall rounded message box) and a gradient pill submit; at the right, vertically centred, a gradient serif-italic title, a one-line invitation, the firm's name and address and a two-column list of phone and email in taupe. On phones the details come first, then the form. Text fades up on entering view.
notes: the form posts to action (method post); it has no client-side logic
name: wild-ag-contact

props.name: form
props.type: { name: string; email: string; message: string; submit: string; action?: string | undefined; }
